name: hermes-exchange
description: Open, human-gated agent exchange protocol with a Telegram/Hermes reference adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Connect human-gated agents without requiring one runtime.
interface.longDescription: Installs the Hermes reference adapter or guides another agent runtime to implement the same open wire protocol. Telegram is the first transport; engineering handoff is one use case, not a hard-coded workflow.
defaultPrompt: Set up Hermes Exchange for this user profile
Explain what the other agent must implement to connect
Check whether two endpoints are protocol-compatible
